content:
maria: Quick sync — EdgeGate (HW partner) is asking for firmware attestation artifacts for the marketplace listing. They want minimal disclosure; legal asked for a redaction/playbook + presign flow by EOD Wed.
sam: Ack. What exactly do they consider sensitive? serials, cert chains, full binaries?
jordan-sis: Main sensitive items: device serials, hw IDs, any embedded keys. Firmware blobs themselves can be shared to our pen vendor under NDA, but public bundle needs redaction + attest statement.
ashley-sec: +1. We also need SOC2 excerpts (scoped controls) and a short attestation letter from EdgeGate. We should map control owners before handing off.
ivan-ops: Proposed minimal deliverables: 1) Redacted firmware metadata bundle (JSON + manifest) 2) Presigned S3 package with 7d expiry 3) Attestation PDF 4) Contact list for 3p vuln vendor access.
maria: Can someone draft a redaction script example and a small runbook for SI so they can reproduce? Keep it simple — ops-friendly.
sam: I can do a quick sed/python example. Suggest we remove lines matching serial|hw_id|mac|device_key and replace with REDACTED. Example:```bash
# redaction example (POSIX)
sed -E -e 's/(serial|hw_id|mac):[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9:-]+/\1: REDACTED/g' manifest.txt > manifest.redacted.txt
```
Also a tiny python alternative if we want JSON-aware:```python
import json, re
with open('manifest.json') as f:
    obj = json.load(f)
for k in ['serial','hw_id','device_key','mac']:
    if k in obj:
        obj[k] = 'REDACTED'
with open('manifest.redacted.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
```
ivan-ops: Nice. For presign we should use 7d expiry, single-use link for the pen vendor, and an audit entry. Example AWS CLI:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/edgegate/firmware-bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```
ashley-sec: Add requirements: - Keep an audit log entry with requestor and purpose - Limit presign to vendor IAM role where possible - Redaction must be performed before any public uploads - Store original unredacted bundles in secure bucket with restricted access and retention policy 1 year
jordan-sis: I'll own collecting the attestation PDF from EdgeGate and confirming the control mapping. Proposed mapping snippet in thread: "Firmware signing" -> devops (sam), "Key management" -> security (ashley), "Vuln scans" -> SI/contact (jordan-sis).
maria: Perfect. Who will run the redaction and upload? Sam volunteer?
sam: I can run the initial redaction and upload to presign path. I’ll create a checklist: 1) verify manifest contains only expected fields 2) run redaction script 3) run hash of redacted bundle 4) upload to secure bucket 5) create presign link 6) notify vendor + create audit log entry
deploy-bot: deploy-bot — created runbook doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/space/marketplace/EdgeGate-redaction-runbook (private link) :white_check_mark:
ashley-sec: One more thing — legal wants a short paragraph we can include in the listing that says "Sensitive device identifiers removed; full artifacts available to authorized parties under NDA." I can draft.
maria: Timeline recap: Sam to produce redacted bundle + presign by Tue EOD, Jordan to get attestation by Wed, Ashley will draft legal paragraph and controls summary. Ivan to ensure audit trail and retention. If anything slips ping me.
sam: On it, will post presign + SHA256 and auditor note once uploaded.
jordan-sis: I’ll loop in EdgeGate PM to get signatures and witness window for vuln scan.
ivan-ops: I’ll also add a small lambda to rotate presigns if vendor requests >7d, and log in CloudTrail.
ashley-sec: Thanks team — small ask but high-impact. :lock: :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks all — marking this thread as the single source of truth for the handshake. If issues, escalate to @maria.
